title: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Vehicles Carrying Dust-Generating Goods) As defined in Article 13(1) of the Act, "goods such as coal, grain, etc., as specified in the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries' ordinance" refers to any of the following:
1. Cement
2. Coal
3. Feed
4. Grain
5. Scrap metal
6. Ores
7. Wood
8. Soil
9. Any other goods that may generate a large amount of dust, as determined and announced by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries
